entities.name: Gravesong Carbine
entities.concept: A sentient bone-alloy carbine that stores echoes from defeated hostile creatures and converts them into temporary precision bonuses.
entities.signature_mechanic: Echo Chamber stores three kill echoes; consuming them stabilizes recoil and marks the next struck target for allied bonus damage.
counterplay: Echo charges expire outside combat; missing the marked shot wastes the strongest window.
entities.visual_identity: Black ivory receiver with thin violet resonance seams and a floating three-notch echo counter.
entities.animation_profile: Reload snaps the bone magazine into place while spectral silhouettes spiral into the chamber; full charge adds a brief shoulder sigil.
entities.vfx_profile: Low-volume violet soul ribbons on kills, compact muzzle glyphs, and a sharp three-ring mark burst on empowered impact.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Epic faction contract chain or rare necropolis cache.

entities.name: Heliophage
entities.concept: A long-form energy rifle that feeds on exposure to open sky and converts stored radiance into a drilling beam.
entities.signature_mechanic: Solar Reservoir charges while outdoors; alternate fire empties stored radiance into a sustained beam that ramps against a single target.
counterplay: Indoor fights deny passive charge; breaking line of sight resets beam ramp.
entities.visual_identity: White-gold spine weapon with rotating heliostat vanes and a captive miniature sun in the stock.
entities.animation_profile: Vaned sections unfold before beam fire, hands brace under escalating recoil, and the core visibly dims as charge is spent.
entities.vfx_profile: Layered solar corona, refractive heat wake, gold-white drilling beam, and armor-molten impact decals with aggressive LOD falloff.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Legendary solar observatory raid reward.

entities.name: Maw of Saint Vanta
entities.concept: A forbidden relic-shotgun whose muzzle resembles a sealed jaw; it grows stronger by devouring status effects from enemies.
entities.signature_mechanic: Devour Sigil strips one eligible hostile status effect from a target and converts it into a temporary empowered shell archetype.
counterplay: Bosses expose only selected effects; stolen shell power decays quickly and demands close-range commitment.
entities.visual_identity: Obsidian jaw housing bound with silver scripture, opening slightly as it senses afflicted enemies.
entities.animation_profile: The weapon recoils like a living bite, teeth flex between shots, and mythic shells are chambered with a ritual hand-over-hand seal.
entities.vfx_profile: Black-violet bite arcs, stolen-effect color inheritance, sigil fragments around the muzzle, and a brief predatory eye flare.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Mythic cathedral-undercrypt boss plus relic attunement.

entities.name: Null Meridian
entities.concept: An exotic rifle that bends its own shot path around geometry after the user establishes a visible anchor point.
entities.signature_mechanic: Meridian Anchor allows the next shot to refract once through a placed spatial anchor, enabling deliberate banked lines of fire.
counterplay: Anchor is visible and destructible; refraction adds charge time and a distinct warning tone.
entities.visual_identity: Thin asymmetrical frame with a floating optic rail and a detached barrel segment suspended by blue-black fields.
entities.animation_profile: Firing through an anchor causes the weapon to pivot independently from the player's hands while the barrel segment realigns in midair.
entities.vfx_profile: Crisp geometric refraction lines, black-blue lens folds, minimal particles, and a sharp spatial snap at the redirect point.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Exotic cartographer faction mastery reward.

entities.name: Thronebreaker Ω
entities.concept: A god-tier anti-boss weapon built to attack distributed weak points on skyscraper-scale creatures rather than ordinary targets.
entities.signature_mechanic: Judgment Chain links consecutive hits on different boss regions; completing the chain detonates synchronized damage across every linked node.
counterplay: Heavy movement penalty in siege mode; chain breaks if the player repeats a node or misses the timing window.
entities.visual_identity: Massive cathedral-cannon silhouette with rotating halo rails, chained barrel braces, and a crown-shaped rear reactor.
entities.animation_profile: Deployment drives luminous braces into the ground, halo rails rotate into alignment, and recoil ripples through the entire rig like a bell strike.
entities.vfx_profile: Cathedral-scale gold shock rings, chained lightning between boss nodes, localized sky darkening, and kilometer-readable judgment markers.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: God-tier raid forge requiring multiple super-boss cores.

entities.name: Eventide Apostate
entities.concept: An Absolute weapon that cycles local combat rules through three authored firing doctrines rather than simply increasing damage.
entities.signature_mechanic: Doctrine Rewrite alternates between Gravity, Silence, and Fracture modes, changing projectile behavior, enemy mobility pressure, and cover interaction.
counterplay: Each doctrine has a long lock-in period; enemies can adapt once the mode is telegraphed and cannot be changed instantly.
entities.visual_identity: Floating black-metal weapon frame with no physical magazine, surrounded by three orbiting doctrine seals.
entities.animation_profile: Orbiting seals slot into the frame to reconfigure its silhouette; each doctrine has a distinct firing posture and reload-like transformation.
entities.vfx_profile: Local gravity ripples, desaturated silence bubbles, fracture-line geometry, and authored world-light response kept within encounter bounds.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Absolute ascension forge and three doctrine trials.

entities.name: Ashcoil Repeater
entities.concept: A fast compact weapon that leaves short-lived heated lanes, rewarding players who strafe and shape enemy movement.
entities.signature_mechanic: Coilwake paints brief thermal trails behind the wielder while firing; crossing trails ignites a burst that punishes pursuers.
counterplay: Standing still wastes the mechanic; enemies can wait for trails to expire or route around them.
entities.visual_identity: Charcoal-metal SMG with orange coil tubing wrapped around a vented receiver.
entities.animation_profile: Coils flex with sustained fire and the stock vents open during overheat recovery.
entities.vfx_profile: Short orange wake strips, heat shimmer, and restrained ember bursts designed for high concurrent use.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Epic infernal foundry caches and faction vendors.

entities.name: Chronoclast Sidearm
entities.concept: A dueling pistol that records a target's recent position and can force a localized echo strike at that prior location.
entities.signature_mechanic: Afterimage Verdict records one enemy location on hit; secondary fire detonates a temporal echo at that recorded point after a short tell.
counterplay: Recorded point is visible to the target; mobile players can deliberately bait the echo away from allies.
entities.visual_identity: Long-barreled silver pistol with a translucent clockwork cylinder and backward-spinning chamber marks.
entities.animation_profile: Every third shot briefly reverses the cylinder animation; Verdict activation snaps the hand backward as if recoil occurs before firing.
entities.vfx_profile: Blue-white afterimages, thin clock glyphs, and a clean temporal inversion pulse with no full-screen distortion.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Legendary chronarch duel challenge.

entities.name: Leviathan's Petition
entities.concept: A mythic launcher built from abyssal shell that creates moving pressure waves instead of conventional explosive spam.
entities.signature_mechanic: Undertow Round creates a traveling pressure front that pushes lesser enemies, exposes buried targets, and amplifies damage against soaked foes.
counterplay: Slow projectile and long reload; anchored elites resist displacement and can punish careless close-range use.
entities.visual_identity: Deep-blue shell launcher with bioluminescent ribs and a rotating pearl chamber.
entities.animation_profile: Weapon visibly inhales before firing, ribs compress inward, and reload pours spectral seawater into the chamber.
entities.vfx_profile: Rolling translucent pressure wall, bioluminescent foam, refracted caustics, and restrained mist at range.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Mythic leviathan hunt and abyss forge.

entities.name: Choir of Ruin
entities.concept: An exotic rifle that harmonizes successive bursts into escalating sonic patterns whose function depends on firing rhythm.
entities.signature_mechanic: Harmonic Sequence recognizes three firing cadences and converts them into stagger, shield fracture, or ally haste pulses.
counterplay: Incorrect cadence resets the sequence; strong effects require readable timing rather than spam.
entities.visual_identity: Tri-barrel black chrome rifle with suspended tuning forks and a luminous waveform sight.
entities.animation_profile: Barrels rotate in measured musical intervals; successful cadences animate the forks into geometric chord shapes.
entities.vfx_profile: Visible waveform ribbons, concentric impact rings, and distinct color-coded harmonic signatures with accessible audio tells.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Exotic resonance conservatory questline.

entities.name: Dreadstar I
entities.concept: The first stage of a living weapon lineage that develops new anatomy and attacks through tracked combat milestones.
entities.signature_mechanic: Predation Ledger records elite kills and biome-specific prey, unlocking permanent visual mutations and branching upgrade choices.
counterplay: Early stage is intentionally below mythic power; growth requires varied targets rather than repetitive farming.
entities.visual_identity: Dark organic rifle with a closed star-shaped organ embedded where the magazine would sit.
entities.animation_profile: Subtle breathing idle, tendon recoil, and mutation-specific reload animations as the star organ opens over progression.
entities.vfx_profile: Black-red capillary light, small predatory motes, and mutation VFX layered by evolution stage.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Legendary living-armory quest; evolves through dedicated milestones.
entities.evolution: Dreadstar I → Awakened → Godkiller → Dreadstar Ω.

entities.name: Parallax Mercy
entities.concept: A mythic support rifle whose precision hits create temporary safe geometry and rescue lanes rather than purely maximizing damage.
entities.signature_mechanic: Mercy Plane converts marked precision impacts into short-lived protective planes that block hostile fire from one direction.
counterplay: Planes protect from one facing only, expire rapidly, and can be flanked.
entities.visual_identity: Pearlescent long rifle with a split prism barrel and thin wing-like stabilization surfaces.
entities.animation_profile: Precision hits unfold a brief wing gesture along the barrel; deploying a Mercy Plane makes the weapon rotate through a ceremonial half-turn.
entities.vfx_profile: Iridescent planar shields, clean prismatic fracture on expiry, and low-noise support pulses to preserve combat readability.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Mythic sanctuary defense achievement chain.

entities.name: Goreglass Stalker
entities.concept: A tall translucent predator whose internal organs appear as floating red silhouettes, using broken reflections to approach prey.
entities.signature_mechanic: Mirror Step lets it teleport only between reflective surfaces it has contaminated, creating positional horror without unrestricted teleport spam.
counterplay: Players can destroy or avoid contaminated mirrors and force it into ordinary pursuit.
entities.visual_identity: Six-limbed glasslike hunter with visible floating anatomy and a split vertical jaw.
entities.animation_profile: Jerky stop-motion prowling transitions into unnaturally smooth mirror emergence; wounded state fractures limbs but does not detach them.
entities.vfx_profile: Subtle reflection warping, red internal silhouettes, glass dust on emergence, and localized chromatic fracture.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Spawns in corrupted urban interiors and mirror crypts.

entities.name: Carrion Parliament
entities.concept: A colony creature formed from dozens of small scavengers that vote through motion and merge into temporary combat shapes.
entities.signature_mechanic: Consensus Form reconfigures the swarm into Shield, Hunter, or Devourer formations based on incoming threats and nearby corpses.
counterplay: Area denial disrupts formation density; burning remains denies corpse-fueled recovery.
entities.visual_identity: Dozens of pale mask-faced scavengers connected by tendon-thin black threads.
entities.animation_profile: Individuals scramble independently until a formation vote triggers a synchronized snap into a larger silhouette.
entities.vfx_profile: Black connective filaments, crawling shadow pool, brief white mask flashes when formation changes.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Legendary horde zones after corruption threshold rises.

entities.name: The Weeping Archon
entities.concept: A levitating cathedral-faced entity that weaponizes line of sight, punishing players who stare too long while protecting allies who look away.
entities.signature_mechanic: Grief Gaze builds exposure on viewers; looking away clears exposure but allows the Archon to advance and empower nearby lesser horrors.
counterplay: Players manage sightlines and rotate attention; solid cover fully breaks gaze buildup.
entities.visual_identity: Towering robed figure with a cathedral facade instead of a face, windows leaking vertical streams of black light.
entities.animation_profile: Moves without walking; robes trail upward against gravity while facade doors slowly open at high exposure.
entities.vfx_profile: Black rain moving upward, stained-glass light wounds, localized vignette only for affected players, and choir-reactive danger cues.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Mythic anomaly event in ruined sanctum regions.

entities.name: Morroweater
entities.concept: A horde apex mutant that evolves by consuming fallen members of its own brood, selecting new anatomy according to what killed them.
entities.signature_mechanic: Carrion Adaptation reads recent brood deaths and grows one counter-trait—armor, mobility, ranged spit, or resistance—for a limited phase.
counterplay: Trait is singular and visibly telegraphed; changing adaptation requires another feeding window that can be interrupted.
entities.visual_identity: Massive asymmetrical brute covered in partially absorbed faces and mismatched limbs that reorganize after feeding.
entities.animation_profile: Feeding is a violent full-body fold over a corpse followed by a clearly staged mutation animation with vulnerable recovery frames.
entities.vfx_profile: Vein maps ignite during adaptation, bone plates grow through dust bursts, and trait colors remain consistent for readability.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Exotic horde escalation stage four and five.

entities.name: Nullskin Pilgrim
entities.concept: A silent humanoid horror wrapped in featureless cloth that tracks repeated player ability use and hunts predictable casters.
entities.signature_mechanic: Pattern Hunger marks the most repeated nearby skill category and gains temporary resistance plus a counter-lunge against that category.
counterplay: Varied ability use prevents strong adaptation; breaking line of sight clears tracking progress.
entities.visual_identity: Featureless tall pilgrim wrapped in matte cloth with a thin moving seam where a face should be.
entities.animation_profile: Slow prayer-like idle abruptly becomes a low quadrupedal sprint when Pattern Hunger completes.
entities.vfx_profile: Almost particle-free silhouette, muted local audio, thin black seam flashes, and a concise silence ring on counter-lunge.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Legendary void pilgrimage encounters.

entities.name: Saint of Teeth
entities.concept: A ceremonial demon carrying hundreds of hovering teeth that constructs temporary ritual geometry around trapped players.
entities.signature_mechanic: Dental Litany places three orbiting tooth pylons; completing the triangle creates a bite-zone that repeatedly snaps inward until one pylon is broken.
counterplay: Pylons are individually targetable; destroying one collapses the triangle and staggers the demon.
entities.visual_identity: Elegant horned demon in ruined vestments with a floating halo made entirely of rotating humanlike teeth.
entities.animation_profile: Combat alternates between graceful liturgical gestures and sudden animal lunges; pylon casting uses precise three-point hand choreography.
entities.vfx_profile: Bone-white glyph triangles, crimson bite-lines, tooth halo trails, and a brief cathedral shadow during successful entrapment.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Mythic demon cathedral incursion.

entities.name: Ash Widow Matriarch
entities.concept: A giant ash-coated arachnid that creates temporary egg-mines and uses smoke to reposition rather than relying on raw durability.
entities.signature_mechanic: Funeral Brood fires egg sacs into terrain; sacs hatch only when players cross their ash sensing radius, enabling controllable ambush fields.
counterplay: Egg sacs can be spotted and destroyed; wind/clear-space encounters reduce smoke advantage.
entities.visual_identity: Charred spider with elongated funeral-spire abdomen and pale ember eyes.
entities.animation_profile: Abdomen opens like a censer for artillery shots; relocation collapses the body into a low smoke crawl before reforming.
entities.vfx_profile: Grey ash sheets, tiny ember eyes through smoke, silk lines visible under direct light, and low-cost hatch bursts.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Epic volcanic nest and cremation forest encounters.

entities.name: Ossuary Engineer
entities.concept: A battlefield necromancer that converts nearby remains into temporary bone fortifications, turrets, and bridges for undead allies.
entities.signature_mechanic: Grave Architecture spends corpse charges to build one of three structures, forcing players to decide whether to clear constructs or rush the caster.
counterplay: Removing corpses denies charges; the Engineer is fragile while channeling construction.
entities.visual_identity: Thin robed necromancer with drafting instruments, a spine-abacus, and folded skeletal measuring arms.
entities.animation_profile: Measures space with snapping bone calipers before structures grow along traced lines; panic state abandons tools and retreats.
entities.vfx_profile: White construction lines, rapid ossified growth, dusty skeletal extrusion, and restrained green necrotic anchors.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Legendary necropolis squads and siege events.

entities.name: The Lantern Below
entities.concept: A buried eldritch organism that projects a harmless-looking lantern avatar above ground to lure players into its attack radius.
entities.signature_mechanic: False Guide presents contextual fake safety cues; damaging or ignoring the lantern reveals buried tendrils and begins the real encounter.
counterplay: Observant players can identify inconsistent lantern behavior and pre-position before triggering the reveal.
entities.visual_identity: Only the lure is visible at first; revealed form is a circular buried maw surrounded by radial armored tendrils.
entities.animation_profile: Lantern sways with almost-human hesitation; reveal inverts the lantern downward as the terrain opens into a radial attack rig.
entities.vfx_profile: Warm inviting glow abruptly inverts to cold abyssal light, with radial ground cracks and dust-constrained tendril effects.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Mythic hidden encounter in caves and dead roads.

entities.name: Red Psalm Butcher
entities.concept: A towering executioner demon whose attack cadence follows a visible ritual meter; skilled players can deliberately force a vulnerable overcommit.
entities.signature_mechanic: Psalm Meter escalates through five verses as it lands attacks; Verse Five is catastrophic but leaves the Butcher exposed if avoided.
counterplay: Perfect spacing and mobility can bait Verse Five into terrain, causing a long self-stagger.
entities.visual_identity: Enormous red-black executioner with scripture chains embedded in the torso and a cleaver taller than a player.
entities.animation_profile: Each verse adds heavier anticipatory motion and larger recovery; Verse Five uses a full-body overhead cleave with unmistakable windup.
entities.vfx_profile: Red scripture bands wrap the arena, cleaver afterimages grow by verse, and Verse Five produces a controlled vertical shock scar.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Exotic infernal tribunal event.

entities.name: Hollow Crown Procession
entities.concept: A god-tier roaming procession of linked giants carrying an empty crown between them, behaving as one moving regional encounter.
entities.signature_mechanic: Coronation March links multiple bodies to a shared ritual state; destroying bearer anchors changes the formation and unlocks the crown core.
counterplay: Players can target bearer anchors in any order to alter later phase difficulty; the core is invulnerable until formation conditions are met.
entities.visual_identity: Four immense faceless giants chained to a floating black crown, followed by smaller masked attendants.
entities.animation_profile: Giants step in synchronized impossible timing; each lost bearer forces the surviving bodies into a new asymmetrical gait and attack language.
entities.vfx_profile: Kilometer-visible crown silhouette, dark procession beams, dust fronts, chained lightning between bearers, and scalable distant impostor effects.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Rare God-tier roaming world event.

entities.name: Abyssal Taxonomist
entities.concept: An Absolute monster that temporarily reclassifies nearby combatants into authored categories and applies different encounter rules to each.
entities.signature_mechanic: Taxonomy Decree assigns temporary labels such as Predator, Prey, Vessel, or Witness, each changing how the encounter targets and pressures that player.
counterplay: Assignments are telegraphed and can be swapped by completing arena actions; coordinated teams can intentionally manipulate classifications.
entities.visual_identity: Impossible floating cabinet of limbs, eyes, specimen drawers, and rotating labels orbiting a central faceless curator.
entities.animation_profile: Drawers open into extra-dimensional gestures, labels stamp onto reality, and limb configurations change with the active taxonomy.
entities.vfx_profile: Floating classification glyphs, restrained localized spatial folds, specimen-light projections, and role-specific aura language.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Absolute anomaly chain after completing all regional eldritch archives.

entities.name: Kael Veyr, Rift Warden
entities.concept: A disciplined rift soldier who protects the hiring squad by physically intercepting danger lanes and creating short-lived breach cover.
entities.signature_mechanic: Guardian Breach teleports Kael to a threatened ally and creates a directional cover plane before counterattacking.
counterplay: Long interception cooldown and cannot protect multiple separated allies simultaneously.
entities.visual_identity: Angular midnight armor with a split cyan mantle and compact rift buckler.
entities.animation_profile: Combat uses grounded military motion punctuated by a single sharp rift-step and shield-brace animation.
entities.vfx_profile: Compact cyan breach plane, geometric teleport cut, restrained shield sparks.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Epic faction reputation hire.

entities.name: Nyx Caldera, Ash Saint
entities.concept: A charismatic infernal renegade who turns burning ground into safe lanes for allies and dangerous funnels for enemies.
entities.signature_mechanic: Saintfire Conversion changes selected hostile fire zones into allied ember sanctuaries that heal slightly and accelerate reloads.
counterplay: Conversion has limited charges and cannot affect boss-authored ultimate hazards.
entities.visual_identity: Elegant black-red saint armor, ember veil, asymmetric halo, and ritual sidearm.
entities.animation_profile: Nyx traces a circle with her heel before snapping fingers to invert a hazard; reload animations use ember-fed magazine seals.
entities.vfx_profile: Fire shifts from red to white-gold inside converted zones, halo expands, and ash rises rather than falls.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Legendary infernal-rebel questline hire.

entities.name: Orion Gravewake
entities.concept: A mythic necromancer ally who does not flood the field with disposable summons; instead he reconstructs selected defeated enemies as short-lived tactical echoes.
entities.signature_mechanic: Gravewake Recall stores one recently defeated non-boss archetype and summons a weakened spectral copy with a limited lifetime.
counterplay: Only one echo can exist at once and copied elites lose signature boss mechanics.
entities.visual_identity: Regal bone-black coat, floating vertebrae crown, and a lantern containing captured silhouettes.
entities.animation_profile: Summoning pulls a silhouette from the lantern and stitches it into a translucent body with deliberate conductor gestures.
entities.vfx_profile: Cold grave mist, blue-black thread stitching, spectral replica shader, and clear despawn countdown rune.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Mythic necromancer covenant mastery hire.

entities.name: Vesper Quill, Impossible Cartographer
entities.concept: An exotic navigator who reveals hidden traversal opportunities and can open temporary shortcuts through otherwise disconnected local spaces.
entities.signature_mechanic: Impossible Route creates a temporary one-way squad portal between two authored nearby anchor categories, never arbitrary map-wide teleportation.
counterplay: Portal endpoints obey authored anchors and have a long cooldown; enemies can see the exit warning.
entities.visual_identity: Long iridescent coat covered in moving map lines, floating compass shards, and a lens-mask with shifting coordinates.
entities.animation_profile: Draws portals by sketching in the air with a metal quill while compass shards rotate into the destination bearing.
entities.vfx_profile: Prismatic contour lines, folded-map portal surface, coordinate rain, and minimal distortion outside the portal rim.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Exotic cartographer faction grandmaster hire.

entities.name: Aurelia Vox, Throne of Storms
entities.concept: A God-tier hireable whose presence changes outdoor combat through controlled storm lanes, aerial pressure, and high-impact ally rescue.
entities.signature_mechanic: Thronefront creates a moving storm wall centered on Aurelia that damages hostile flyers, deflects light projectiles, and periodically launches chain bolts.
counterplay: Domain weakens indoors and has a long recovery after its major discharge.
entities.visual_identity: Regal storm armor with floating crown fragments, luminous cape-cloud, and spear-like lightning focus.
entities.animation_profile: Hover locomotion with controlled cape turbulence; major cast assembles crown fragments into a vertical storm throne silhouette.
entities.vfx_profile: Layered cloud crown, branching lightning with strict target caps, wind ribbons, and distant storm-column landmark effect.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: God-tier storm covenant, world-boss proof, and high-cost hire contract.

entities.name: Seraphine Veyra, First Ascendant
entities.concept: An Absolute support entity who manipulates encounter recovery, temporary allied manifestations, and localized battlefield reconstruction.
entities.signature_mechanic: Genesis Rewrite restores selected allied combat state, creates short-lived spectral ally doubles, and deploys authored cover structures in one synchronized cast.
counterplay: Once-per-major-encounter ultimate; doubles inherit reduced power and generated cover is temporary.
entities.visual_identity: Celestial black-and-gold armor with luminous feather geometry, a broken halo, and constellations moving beneath translucent fabric.
entities.animation_profile: Movement alternates graceful grounded swordwork with short zero-gravity transitions; Genesis Rewrite is a multi-stage orchestral cast.
entities.vfx_profile: Constellation geometry, luminous reconstruction lattices, spectral ally duplication, skyward feather arcs, and localized brightness caps.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Absolute endgame covenant; limited high-cost hire access.

entities.name: Astraeus Null, Lawbreaker
entities.concept: An Absolute control specialist who temporarily changes local movement and projectile assumptions inside a clearly bounded encounter zone.
entities.signature_mechanic: Null Dominion creates a bounded zero-law arena where selected movement, gravity-like impulses, and projectile pacing are replaced by authored encounter rules.
counterplay: Domain has a visible boundary, short duration, and cannot override protected boss mechanics or global island rules.
entities.visual_identity: Black voidplate with white fracture seams, no visible face, and orbiting debris held at impossible angles.
entities.animation_profile: Idle debris continuously reorients; Dominion activation unfolds armor plates while the character rises into a rigid axis-cross pose.
entities.vfx_profile: Localized monochrome boundary, suspended particles/projectiles where supported, geometric white fractures, and strict VFX culling at edge.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Absolute endgame covenant; limited high-cost hire access.

entities.name: Mira Sable, Beast-Crown
entities.concept: A mythic beastmaster who dramatically improves taming reliability and can temporarily command one normally hostile elite beast archetype.
entities.signature_mechanic: Royal Scent marks one eligible elite creature and opens a short taming challenge instead of immediately converting it.
counterplay: Bosses and protected mythic entities are never eligible; failed challenge enrages the creature.
entities.visual_identity: Predatory ceremonial armor layered with claws, antlers, feathers, and a living mantle that reacts to nearby beasts.
entities.animation_profile: Taming uses low posture, hand signs, and synchronized breath timing; combat animation borrows movement motifs from the active companion species.
entities.vfx_profile: Species-colored scent ribbons, crown-shaped taming sigil, subdued animal-spirit silhouettes.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Mythic wild-court reputation hire.

entities.name: Bell-Tower Revenant
entities.concept: A dead siege knight fused to a walking bell tower; every heavy strike rings the tower and changes nearby undead behavior.
entities.signature_mechanic: Funeral Peal cycles three bell tones that respectively rally, frenzy, or recall undead adds.
counterplay: Breaking exposed bell braces disables one tone and permanently simplifies the encounter.
entities.visual_identity: Armored giant carrying a cracked bell tower through its torso, with chains dragging behind.
entities.animation_profile: Heavy knight attacks are synchronized to pendulum motion inside the chest; brace destruction changes posture and gait.
entities.vfx_profile: Bronze shock rings, ghostly bell resonance, chain sparks, and dust-heavy ground hits.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Regional grave-march event.

entities.name: Vorun, Cathedral Devourer
entities.concept: A demon the size of a fortress chapel whose ribs form walkable platforms and whose attacks reorganize the arena.
entities.signature_mechanic: Living Nave opens sections of Vorun's body as temporary combat spaces; squads must enter, destroy organs, and escape before the ribs close.
counterplay: Organ windows are telegraphed; exterior weak points can extend escape time for teams struggling inside.
entities.visual_identity: Fortress-scale demon with cathedral ribs, stained-glass membranes, and towers growing from the spine.
entities.animation_profile: Boss body doubles as level geometry during phase windows; ribs open mechanically like vast doors while head and arms continue attacking.
entities.vfx_profile: Stained-glass internal light, hellish organ pulses, giant shadow sweeps, controlled debris, and distant silhouette LOD.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Legendary raid progression.

entities.name: Eidolon of the Drowned Moon
entities.concept: A mythic ocean/sky leviathan whose body appears in separate regions as the event progresses, making the encounter feel far larger than one arena.
entities.signature_mechanic: Tidal Orbit moves the fight through shoreline, flooded ruins, and elevated moonfall phases while sharing one persistent boss state.
counterplay: Each phase exposes different counters; failing regional objectives buffs the next phase rather than instantly wiping the team.
entities.visual_identity: Serpentine leviathan with crescent skeletal fins and a luminous drowned-moon organ visible through translucent abyssal skin.
entities.animation_profile: Long-form swim/fly motion uses distant spline-like presentation and local attack rigs; phase transitions include enormous breach animations.
entities.vfx_profile: Ocean-scale caustics, moonlit fog, controlled water walls, distant body silhouettes, and high-detail local weak-point effects.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Mythic global event chain.

entities.name: The Crownless Continent
entities.concept: A God-tier distributed boss presented as a moving landmass-creature whose local body regions become separate raid fronts for squads.
entities.signature_mechanic: Sovereign Anatomy divides the creature into simultaneous raid sectors—limbs, armor cities, heart vents, and crown wound—all contributing to shared phase state.
counterplay: No single sector can finish the phase alone; sectors expose complementary vulnerabilities and recover if abandoned too long.
entities.visual_identity: A mountain-range colossus carrying ruined cities and forests across its back, visible as a world landmark long before combat.
entities.animation_profile: Far-distance locomotion is environmental/cinematic; local sectors use bespoke animated body geometry, attack rigs, and traversal sequences.
entities.vfx_profile: World-sky silhouette, sector-local shockwaves, atmospheric debris, aurora-like health-state signals, and aggressive distance-based VFX substitution.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: God-tier server/world event unlocked by multi-region prerequisites.

entities.name: Void Sovereign Panoply
entities.concept: A mythic armor set built around rift mobility and void-energy recovery, with bonuses that progressively alter class movement and summons.
entities.signature_mechanic: Sovereign Form unlocks at full set, granting a brief transformation where rift movement gains an extra authored exit effect and summons inherit void shielding.
counterplay: Set power depends on coordinated pieces and transformation has a strict cooldown.
entities.visual_identity: Layered black armor with floating plate gaps, violet interior stars, and a crown-like collar.
entities.animation_profile: Pieces assemble during Sovereign Form; cloth and plates momentarily lose gravity before snapping into a sharper silhouette.
entities.vfx_profile: Violet starfield seams, rift afterimages, orbiting armor fragments during transformation, and strict particle caps.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Mythic void citadel crafting chain.

entities.name: Ashen Seraph Harness
entities.concept: A legendary armor set for players who fight inside hazardous zones, converting controlled environmental risk into squad support.
entities.signature_mechanic: Martyr Heat stores limited hazard exposure and releases it as a cleansing pulse when the wearer exits danger.
counterplay: Storage caps quickly and overexposure still damages the wearer; safe play yields no charge.
entities.visual_identity: Charred wing-shaped back plates, white-hot seams, and a half-halo fixed behind one shoulder.
entities.animation_profile: Stored heat progressively opens the wing plates; cleanse snaps them fully outward before cooling shut.
entities.vfx_profile: White ember feathers, heat shimmer, circular cleanse pulse, and visible charge seams.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Legendary infernal-rebel forge.

entities.name: Chronarch Regent Array
entities.concept: A God-tier armor array that rewards precise timing by banking narrowly avoided damage windows and converting them into temporal charges.
entities.signature_mechanic: Regent Interval detects authored near-miss conditions and spends accumulated intervals to accelerate one skill cycle without globally speeding the player.
counterplay: Requires risky timing; charges are lost on heavy stagger and cannot accelerate Transcendent abilities.
entities.visual_identity: Regal silver armor with rotating clock rings behind joints and a transparent chest chronometer.
entities.animation_profile: Near-misses briefly desynchronize limb afterimages; full charge aligns every ring before a single sharp time-snap gesture.
entities.vfx_profile: Layered afterimages, concentric clock rings, clean time-snap shock, no persistent full-screen distortion.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: God-tier chronarch trials and raid forge.

entities.name: Axiom Vestment
entities.concept: An Absolute armor system that visually and mechanically reconfigures according to which authored encounter doctrine the player activates.
entities.signature_mechanic: Axiom Mantle swaps between Bastion, Pursuit, and Dominion configurations, each changing defensive, movement, and authority-support behavior.
counterplay: Configuration locks for a meaningful duration; swapping is disabled during certain boss ultimate windows.
entities.visual_identity: Black-white ceremonial armor whose plates are separated by impossible negative space and orbit a luminous core.
entities.animation_profile: Full-body transformation rebuilds plate topology in stages, changing stance and locomotion accents for each configuration.
entities.vfx_profile: White geometric law-lines, black negative-space cuts, orbiting plate trails, and localized environment response within authored bounds.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Absolute ascension crafting and doctrine mastery.

entities.name: Night of a Million Teeth
entities.concept: A timed invasion where tooth-bearing horrors emerge from architecture, wildlife dens, sewers, and battlefield remains while players defend moving sanctuary zones.
entities.signature_mechanic: Predation Index tracks regional fear pressure; aggressive successful defense lowers mutation quality while failed objectives unlock nastier enemy combinations.
counterplay: Players can recover a failing event by destroying ritual anchors and escorting sanctuary beacons.
entities.visual_identity: The affected region gains tooth-like architectural growths, black rain, and moving sanctuary lights.
entities.animation_profile: World props pulse subtly with the spawn rhythm; sanctuary beacons physically unfold as defense objectives move.
entities.vfx_profile: Scalable black rain, tooth-growth material swaps, sanctuary columns, and event-wide sky treatment with platform-safe fallbacks.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Rare mythic world-event scheduler.

entities.name: The Choosing of Zero
entities.concept: An ultra-rare endgame event entered only by qualified Zero Candidates, combining combat, resource management, navigation, puzzle logic, and individual mastery.
entities.signature_mechanic: The Choosing dynamically scores multiple authored disciplines and culminates in a final candidate-specific trial; completion grants eligibility for Transcendent Zero rather than a simple loot drop.
counterplay: Failure preserves most prerequisite progress but imposes a retry lock and consumes selected ascension resources.
entities.visual_identity: An impossible arena assembled from fragments of every major biome around a central black-white zero monolith.
entities.animation_profile: Biome fragments rotate and reconfigure between trials; final success triggers a long-form ascension sequence with armor reconstruction and sky fracture.
entities.vfx_profile: World-scale but bounded zero sigil, biome transition wipes, black-white sky fractures, constellation collapse, and a heavily LOD-managed global announcement effect.
entities.audio_profile: Tier-scaled positional audio with signature activation, impact, danger, and cooldown cues.
entities.acquisition: Only available to authenticated Zero Candidates who complete all prerequisite systems.
